title: Boston Dynamics Stretch 搬箱系統
summary: 用靜態吸附力模型比較密封良好與漏氣的紙箱表面。
summaryEn: Compare sealed and leaking carton surfaces with a static suction-force model.

References establish case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and acceptance limits are stated teaching assumptions, not equipment specifications, production recipes, clinical instructions, or flight procedures.
